raw_segments.text: His smile faded as he walked, a heavy cloud hiding the sun slowly, shadowing trinities
Trams passed one another, ingoing, outgoing, clanging, useless words.
Things go on same, day after day, squads of police marching out back, trams in out, those
two loonies mooching about, dignum carted off, mean a purifoy swollen belly on a bed
groaning to have a child tugged out of her.
One born every second somewhere, other dying every second, since I fed the birds five minutes.
Three hundred kicked the bucket, other three hundred born, washing the blood off, all are
washed in the blood of the lamb, bawling meh.
